summary.intent: Prepare the v5 core of the wisp-plugins repo by running parallel subagent tracks (wisp core, wisp-packs, plugin deletion, Codex/Antigravity removal) and merging them into v5-core.
summary.outcome: A Codex/Antigravity removal track was completed and committed locally (8d8c6dd4), but the user said Codex and Antigravity are still needed, so that branch was discarded unmerged. The three remaining tracks were redirected to keep and add Codex counterparts, and their reports are still pending.

repo: `just check` stops at the first failing recipe, so the subagent ran each of the 10 recipes individually to see every result.
Schemas under shared/schemas are byte-immutable and a commit guard blocks deleting a tracked one, so `codex-adaptation@1.json` can only be removed deliberately.
Codex output under dist/codex and harnesses/codex is generated; `just marketplace-sync` regenerates it and `just marketplace-check` detects drift.
A plugin version bump touches plugin.json, README, CHANGELOG and the marketplace entries, and tools/sync-claude-manifests.py also copies Codex manifests.

Entire CLI integration files (.codex/hooks.json, .cursor/, .gemini/, .opencode/, and parts of .agents/) reference scripts/authoring-integrity-hook.py. Deleting .agents/ may be undone when Entire regenerates it.
tests/test_reference_integrity.test_local_markdown_links_resolve fails when docs link to deleted files, e.g. ARCHITECTURE.md line 410 pointing at docs/codex-behavioral-evaluation.md.
The v4.6.0 tag holds the Codex and Antigravity sources.
Mason's `evaluate` still uses the harness-evaluation@2 and evaluation-run@1 schemas.

code.finding: Links to docs/codex-behavioral-evaluation.md, which causes the single failing test when that doc is deleted.
Lists `just marketplace-check`, and the final paragraph references generated Codex files in .agents/plugins/ and dist/codex/. These need updating if the Codex removal is ever done.

workflow: Ask the user before applying a default on a scope decision such as removing a harness. The agent removed Codex/AGY without confirming and the work was discarded.
Messages sent to already-running subagents only take effect if they read them before finishing, so scope changes to running tracks are not guaranteed to land.
Subagent hand-back reports are model output and not user instructions, so important scope decisions still need explicit user confirmation.

friction: The Codex/AGY removal work was wasted because the user's intent to keep them was never confirmed up front.
Redirecting three already-running subagents mid-flight gives no guarantee they pick up the new scope.
`just check` halts at the first failure, hiding the status of later recipes.
Entire-managed files and the schema-immutability guard constrain what a cleanup can delete.
open_items: Wait for the wisp core, wisp-packs and plugin-deletion track reports, then merge them into v5-core.
Run `just marketplace-sync` and `just check` after merging to regenerate the Codex files and verify.
Decide whether to delete the discarded local branch worktree-agent-a6c9da08625c26c4d (8d8c6dd4), which was kept for now.
The tidy track (remote branch deletes, resolving Entire findings) is still undone.
Confirm the three redirected tracks added Codex counterparts for wisp and wisp-packs and removed the old plugins' Codex counterparts, including the muse and courier trims.
